column3: BSB recasts the verse: “as you hold out your faith … do not show favoritism”; “glorious” renders “of glory.”
BSB renders “sit here honorably” as “Here is a seat of honor” and “under my footstool” as “at my feet.”
BSB renders “the poor in the world” as “the poor of this world,” the wording of the Textus Receptus.
BSB renders “called upon you” as “by which you have been called.”
Close to the Greek; “that gives freedom” renders “of freedom.”
BSB renders “the needful things for the body” as “his physical needs.”
BSB renders “if it does not have works” as “if it does not result in action.”
BSB renders “You do well” as “Good for you!”
BSB follows the critical text with “worthless” (ἀργή); the Textus Receptus reads “dead.” “Evidence” renders “to come to know.”
